videoAnalyses.title: 17 - Chest and Triceps B
videoAnalyses.summary: This video provides a 30-minute chest and triceps workout routine consisting of seven different exercises. Each exercise is performed for three sets of 10 repetitions, with a 60-second rest period between each set.

keyMoments.description: Demonstration of the Machine Chest Press exercise.
Demonstration of the Low Pulley Cable Fly exercise.
Demonstration of the Machine Chest Fly exercise.
Demonstration of the Decline Cable Crossover exercise.
Demonstration of the Triceps Bench Dips exercise.
Demonstration of the Cable Rope Pushdown exercise.
Demonstration of the Dumbbell Triceps Kickback exercise.

curriculum.targetTransformation: Build shoulders and chest that actually show

lessons.title: Execute your first two chest machine exercises with correct form
lessons.summary: Learners perform the Machine Chest Press and Low Pulley Cable Fly for 3 sets of 10 reps each, establishing the foundational push-and-fly pattern for chest development.

sessions.title: Machine Chest Press & Low Pulley Cable Fly
sessions.summary: Build the foundation of your chest workout by mastering the two opening exercises: the Machine Chest Press and the Low Pulley Cable Fly, each performed for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rest periods.

lessons.title: Complete the full Chest A workout from start to finish
lessons.summary: Learners work through the complete Chest and Triceps A session, applying the 3-sets-of-10 structure across all exercises in this alternate chest workout variation.

sessions.title: Chest and Triceps A — Full Session
sessions.summary: Follow the complete Chest and Triceps A workout routine, applying the same 3-sets-of-10-reps and 60-second rest structure to every exercise in this alternate session.

clips.chapterTitle: Chest and Triceps A — Full Workout

lessons.title: Build triceps strength with Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns
lessons.summary: Learners isolate the triceps for the first time, executing Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns for 3 sets of 10 reps each to develop the pushing muscles that support every chest movement.

sessions.title: Triceps Bench Dips & Cable Rope Pushdowns
sessions.summary: Shift focus from chest to triceps by performing Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns — the two key triceps exercises in the B session — for 3 sets of 10 reps with 60-second rest periods.

steps.title: Perform Triceps Bench Dips and Cable Rope Pushdowns using the 3×10 protocol

lessons.title: Finish the full chest B session with the Machine Chest Fly and Decline Cable Crossover
lessons.summary: Learners complete the remaining two chest exercises from the B session — Machine Chest Fly and Decline Cable Crossover — and can now execute the entire Chest and Triceps B workout from start to finish.

sessions.title: Machine Chest Fly & Decline Cable Crossover
sessions.summary: Complete the chest portion of the B session by mastering the Machine Chest Fly and Decline Cable Crossover, each for 3 sets of 10 reps, so you can run the full Chest and Triceps B workout independently.
